facts.text: The John B. Begley Scholarship covers full tuition, room, and board for three incoming freshmen each year alongside dedicated cultural enrichment trips.

sources.title: Begley Scholars - Lindsey Wilson University
sources.quote: The Begley Scholarship is a full-tuition, room & board scholarship awarded to three incoming freshman students each year. Beyond financial reward, the Begley Scholarship Program seeks to provide students with an unparalleled cultural enrichment experience.
